title: ReLoop listing metadata
description: Structured re-commerce metadata and Kleinanzeigen-style listing copy derived from user-supplied photos and notes. Unknown scalar values are null. For the assessable lists (visible_defects, included_accessories, missing_accessories), null means not assessed and [] means assessed with nothing found or confirmed. See references/extraction-rules.md.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the document conforms to.

revision.description: Starts at 1 and increments with each update in the same conversation.

photo_set_interpretation.description: What the supplied photos show as a set.

photos.description: Every photo the user supplied in this conversation, in the order received.

photo_upload_order.description: Recommended upload order for the Kleinanzeigen 'Bilder' field (max. 20 images); the first entry is the cover photo. Lists only inspected photos; empty when none were inspected.

item_name.description: Short human-readable name of the offered item or bundle.

item_type.description: Generic product type, for example 'Computer monitor'.

brand.description: Brand. Non-null only when supported by a logo, a readable label, the user or a cited source.

model.description: Exact model identifier that applies to the whole offer. Null when unreadable, unconfirmed or differing between units.

quantity.description: Number of physical units offered. Null when unknown or ambiguous.

sale_configuration.description: single_item: one item offered. individual_units: several units, each sold separately. bundle: everything sold together as one lot. unknown: not yet stated.

units.description: Per-unit facts when units differ or were assessed individually. Use an empty array when units are not distinguished.

suggested_category.description: Human-readable marketplace category suggestion. Not an official category ID.

physical_condition.description: Overall cosmetic condition. Null when not assessed.

functional_status.description: Whether the item works. Null when not assessed or not applicable.

visible_defects.description: Defects or damage. null = not assessed; [] = assessed and none seen or confirmed.

included_accessories.description: Accessories confirmed as included. null = not assessed; [] = confirmed that nothing is included. A non-empty list does not imply nothing else is included.

missing_accessories.description: Accessories confirmed as missing. null = not assessed; [] = confirmed that nothing is missing.

attributes.description: Category-specific attributes such as screen size, colour or capacity.

evidence.description: Evidence records supporting, qualifying or contradicting fields.

unknowns.description: Important information that is still unknown or unresolved.

clarification_questions.description: At most three high-value questions for the next turn.

listing_title.description: German listing title (Kleinanzeigen 'Titel', max. 65 characters). Null when there is not enough supported information.

listing_description.description: German listing description (Kleinanzeigen 'Beschreibung', max. 4000 characters). Null when there is not enough supported information.

listing_translations.description: The same listing in other languages, keyed by language code.

listing_title.description: Matches the 65-character limit of the Kleinanzeigen title field.

listing_description.description: Matches the 4000-character limit of the Kleinanzeigen description field.

physical_condition.description: new_sealed: factory seal intact (seen or user-confirmed). unused_open_box: user states never used, packaging opened. light_wear: minor marks only. moderate_wear: clearly visible scratches or scuffs. heavy_wear: extensive wear. damaged: cracks, dents, breaks or missing parts of the item itself. mixed: units differ (see units).

functional_status.description: working: user (or a cited test) reports it works. partially_working: some functions fail. not_working: reported defective. untested: the user states it has not been tested. mixed: units differ (see units).

ref.description: Host-provided identifier, or a session label such as photo_1. Never a URL.

origin.description: host_identifier: id given by the host. session_label: label assigned in this conversation.

inspected.description: True only if the image itself was actually viewed.

shows.description: Brief neutral description of what the photo shows. Null if not inspected.

ref.description: Ref of an inspected photo listed in photos.

note.description: Short German hint before uploading, e.g. 'Seriennummer abdecken'; null if none.

name.description: Stable snake_case attribute name, for example screen_size or colour.

unit.description: Unit of measure, for example 'inch' or 'cm'; null if not applicable.

id.description: Stable identifier; never renumbered across revisions.

field_path.description: JSON Pointer to the field this evidence concerns, for example /model or /attributes/0.

photo_ref.description: Ref of the supporting photo (required for photo and readable_label sources).

observation.description: Concise observation, short label excerpt or paraphrase of the user statement. No serial numbers or personal data.

url.description: Source URL for external_reference evidence; otherwise null.

certainty.description: Qualitative, not a calibrated probability. supported: directly backed. tentative: plausible but unconfirmed. unknown: the evidence does not settle the question.

user_confirmation.description: none: not addressed by the user. confirmed: the user explicitly confirmed. corrected: the user explicitly corrected an earlier value.
